people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Mephibosheth
people.line: Son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, and fell on his face, and showed respect. David said, “Mephibosheth.” He answered, “Behold, your servant!”
translations.bsb: And when Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he fell facedown in reverence. Then David said, “Mephibosheth!” “I am your servant,” he replied.
translations.kjv: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!
translations.asv: And Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came unto David, and fell on his face, and did obeisance. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold, thy servant!
